summary.title: Alert summary
summary.description: Plain-language result of the alert: whether an internal follow-up task was raised for the assigned auditor, the rule violations it covers, and that a human decides.

alertCreated.title: Alert task created
alertCreated.description: True when a new internal follow-up task was created for the assigned auditor.

alreadyAlerted.title: Already alerted
alreadyAlerted.description: True when an open violation-alert task already existed, so no duplicate was created.

violationCount.title: Violation count
violationCount.description: Number of rule violations found on the case's latest replay.
